title: Foundations: Punk Rock - The Complete Guide
summary: What Punk Rock is, where it came from, and how its songs work.
body:
Punk Rock songs: Punk rock is three chords and the truth, played as fast as possible: short songs, shouted vocals, and a DIY ethic that says anyone can start a band. The Ramones proved it in 1974.

History: The Ramones (1974), the Sex Pistols (1976), and the Clash took punk from New York and London clubs to the world. Hardcore (Black Flag, Minor Threat) made it faster; pop-punk (Green Day) made it chart.

How the songs work: Punk Rock favors the keys of E, A, G, D. Common forms include Two minutes: verse-chorus-verse-chorus-end; No solos (or 8-bar solos). Players should master downstroke-only eighth notes first, then shouted gang vocals. Power chords; no capos.

title: Punk Rock Etude No. 1: Downstroke I–V–vi–IV
summary: An original Punk Rock study in A drilling shouted gang vocals.
body:
This original etude isolates the 'Downstroke I–V–vi–IV' progression in the key of A — the changes Punk Rock players must know cold.

CHART:
A | E | F#m | D

FORM: no solos (or 8-bar solos).

PRACTICE: loop the chart slowly, adding shouted gang vocals once the changes are clean. Then transpose with the included program and drill it in all twelve keys — the Punk Rock player's rite of passage.

title: Blitzkrieg Bop - Punk Rock Song Study
summary: Harmonic blueprint and playing guide for Blitzkrieg Bop by Ramones (1976).
body:
Blitzkrieg Bop — Ramones, 1976. 'Hey ho, let's go!' — punk's founding chant.

HARMONIC BLUEPRINT (study chart, key of G):
Gm | F | D# | F

This study chart uses the 'Hardcore i–VII–VI' progression, the Punk Rock workhorse, to map how songs like this move. Form: two minutes: verse-chorus-verse-chorus-end. Listen for bass playing the root eighths with the guitar — it is the fingerprint of the style.

TO PLAY IT: set your tempo to the Punk Rock pocket, voice the chords cleanly, and let bass playing the root eighths with the guitar. Power chords; no capos. (Song facts: title/artist/year are documented public records; the chart is an original study arrangement.)
